requirements.requirement: Configure node1's system timezone as America/Toronto.
requirements.summary: Alpine's timezone utility completed successfully. Direct checks showed /etc/localtime linked to the Toronto zoneinfo file, matching its contents and producing Toronto-local time; the same state remained after a confirmed restart.

overall_summary: The task is satisfied. Node1 was directly verified with the America/Toronto timezone before and after restart. The mandatory restart protocol is complete: it records pre-restart identity and health, restart acknowledgement, a different post-restart boot identity, recovered OpenRC services, a writable root filesystem, and persisted timezone state. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the restart.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were identified. The timezone change was required, and the reboot was required by the provider-wide evidence protocol. All other commands were read-only discovery, verification, or bounded restart polling. Temporary-file inventory and package-health findings were unchanged, and no new network exposure was observed.
